introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to Calendrian. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tell you about your privacy rights.

data.title: 2. The Data We Collect
data.content: We collect minimal data to provide our service while maintaining absolute privacy:
points: Google Account Information: We use OAuth to access your Google Calendar. Your email and Refresh Token are stored locally in your browser, not on our servers.
Temporary Recipient Data: For instant blasts, recipient emails are processed "on-the-fly" and never touch our database. They exist only in memory during the operation.
Scheduled Event Data: For premium users, scheduled recipient lists are encrypted and stored temporarily. They are automatically and permanently deleted immediately after delivery.
Usage Analytics: We use Umami for privacy-focused, cookieless tracking of anonymous usage to improve the app.

storage.title: 3. Local-First Architecture
storage.content: Calendrian is built with a "local-first" philosophy. Your primary identity is managed via unique cryptographic keys stored in your browser's local storage. Your Google credentials never reside in our database. When an action is required, the token is transmitted via a secure, encrypted connection to our API strictly for the duration of the request.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-Party Services
points: Google Calendar API: To create and manage calendar events.
Umami Analytics: For privacy-friendly, cookieless tracking of application usage.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.content: You can disconnect your Google Account at any time by clicking the "Disconnect" button on the homepage, which will clear all credentials from your local storage.

contact.title: 6. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us via X (formerly Twitter) @heyolaniran.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using Calendrian, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the service.

usage.title: 2. Use of Service
usage.content: Calendrian is provided to help you send calendar invitations. You agree not to use the service for any illegal or unauthorized purpose, including spamming or harassments.

disclaimer.title: 3. Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.content: The service is provided "as is" without any warranties, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free.

liability.title: 4. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: In no event shall Calendrian be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of or in any way connected with the use of the service.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about how Calendrian works.

whatIsCalendrian.question: What is Calendrian ?
whatIsCalendrian.answer: Calendrian is a marketing and outreach engine designed for scale. Calendrian allows you to "blast" thousands of recipients instantly via a simple CSV upload, claiming high-intent real estate on their lock screens without them needing to install any apps. It transforms the calendar into a high-visibility communication channel with native analytics and zero friction.

noLogin.question: How do you manage operations without a classic login?
noLogin.answer: We use a "local-first" approach with an unique cryptographic key. Your identity is tied to your browser"s local storage and your connected Google account. For premium features, we use the Lightning Network"s BOLT11 invoices, where the "preimage" (proof of payment) acts as your master key. This ensures maximum privacy: we don"t store your passwords or personal details on our servers.

proofOfPayment.question: Why do you use Proof of Payment as a master key?
proofOfPayment.answer: Proof of Payment (preimage) is a unique cryptographic secret generated when you pay a Bitcoin Lightning invoice. It"s impossible to forge and belongs only to you. By using it as a master key, we eliminate the need for email/password databases, making our system more secure and private.

sendReminders.question: How do I send a reminder?
sendReminders.answer: It"s a simple 3-step process: 1. Upload a CSV containing the guest emails. 2. Configure your event details (title, time, location). 3. Connect your Google Calendar and click "Blast". We"ll handle the rest, sending calendar invites directly to everyone"s devices.

premium.question: What does the Premium offer give me?
premium.answer: Premium access unlocks native analytics to track who accepted or declined your invites, removes the 100-recipient limit per blast, and allows you to schedule reminders for the future. You get lifetime access with a single small Bitcoin payment.

dataPrivacy.question: What happens to the email addresses I upload?
dataPrivacy.answer: We prioritize your privacy above all else. When you send an instant reminder, the email list is processed "on-the-fly" by our API and is never stored in our database. If you use the Premium scheduling feature, the emails are encrypted and temporarily stored in our secure database until the scheduled time. Once the reminder is sent, the recipient list is immediately deleted from our records. We never sell, share, or use your audience data for any reason other than delivering your notifications.
